Iris Patel: Hi folks, quick new-hire security question. I just got a company laptop but still get some personal emails forwarded there from my old account. Is it OK to keep forwarding personal->work temporarily? Also saw the phish sim notice 99	when do those typically hit?

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Security Basics assigned to @Iris Patel, due in 14 days (2001234567). PhishSim cadence: randomized quarterly tests.

Sam (Security): Welcome Iris! Do NOT forward personal email into your work mailbox. Forwarding personal->work creates data leakage risk and can trigger DLP rules. If you need a specific message, export it and upload to your personal archive, or request People Ops to set a temporary monitored rule. Phish sims happen quarterly; failing one just assigns a short remediation module.

IT Support: If you have forwarding enabled in Gmail, disable it: Settings -> Forwarding and POP/IMAP -> Disable. If you need certain personal alerts at work for a short window, open a ticket titled "temporary personal-forwarding" and we'll evaluate. Also confirm MDM enrollment: macOS command: `sudo profiles status -type enrollment`.

Iris Patel: Thanks, disabling forwarding now and I'll open a ticket if I need exceptions. Appreciate the quick answer! :wave:
